actions: import pyautogui; pyautogui.click(534, 532); import time; time.sleep(1)

import pyautogui, time; pyautogui.click(900, 400); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('delete'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.write('Sub DoTask
oDoc = ThisComponent
oSheets = oDoc.Sheets
s1 = oSheets.getByIndex(0)
oCur = s1.createCursor()
oCur.gotoEndOfUsedArea(False)
nLast = oCur.RangeAddress.EndRow
sA = 0.0
sB = 0.0
For i = 1 To nLast
sA = sA + s1.getCellByPosition(0, i).getValue()
sB = sB + s1.getCellByPosition(1, i).getValue()
Next i
If oSheets.hasByName("Sheet2") Then
oSheets.removeByName("Sheet2")
End If
oSheets.insertNewByName("Sheet2", oSheets.Count)
s2 = oSheets.getByName("Sheet2")
s2.getCellByPosition(0,0).setString("Total Revenue")
s2.getCellByPosition(1,0).setString("Total Expenses")
s2.getCellByPosition(0,1).setValue(sA)
s2.getCellByPosition(1,1).setValue(sB)
oDoc.store()
End Sub', interval=0.01)
